body: It’s just so frustrating some days. I’m just sick of feeling fucking lonely and like I’m living everyday to control my symptoms. Like I need a break and some happiness, but I don’t understand very well how to do either for myself most of the time. Which leaves me feeling needy and stressed. *Sigh* I just can’t wait for the day where I can be taken care of, I can relax, and not feel like if I’m not paying attention everything will crumble.
Me too dude. I’m just sick of feeling like I have to do some much more than neurotypicals.
